defs.def: the unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia and several other countries 元（美国、加拿大、澳大利亚等国的货币单位）

ex.s: And while many took dollars, many others pinned their own cash to the board.
ex.t: 虽然许多人拿了钱，但也有许多人把自己的现金别在板上。

ex.s: “There’s a certain feeling that giving can do for you and that was apparent in those that gave the most." Most people who took dollars took only a few, but Bridges said a very small number took as much as they could.
ex.t: "给予能给人带来一种特定的感觉，这在那些给得最多的人身上表现得非常明显。"大多数拿钱的人只拿了几张，但布里奇斯说有极少数人尽可能多地拿。

defs.def: a banknote or coin worth one dollar 一元（纸币或硬币）
the value of the US dollar compared with the value of the money of other countries 美元（币值）

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每张鸭票所筹的每一美元中，约有98美分直接汇入候鸟保护基金，用于购置湿地和野生动物栖息地，并将其纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将受到保护，并为子孙后代所用。

ex.s: “What’s new,” Johnson wrote, “is that millions of dollars are now potentially available to quantum computing researchers.”
ex.t: "新的变化是，"Johnson写道，"现在可能有数百万美元可用于量子计算研究人员。"

ex.s: Since 1934, better than half a billion dollars has gone into that Fund to purchase more than 5 million acres of habitat.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，超过5亿美元进入该基金，用于购买500多万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: Last week she walked up to the store, but when she went to pay for her groceries, she was   39   about three dollars.
ex.t: 上周她走到店里，但当她要付买杂货的钱时，她____39____了大约三美元。

ex.s: "We even had a bride in her wedding dress come up to the board and take a few dollars." Most of the bills on the board were singles, but a few people left fives, tens and even twenties.
ex.t: “我们甚至有一位穿着婚纱的新娘走到板前拿了几美元。”板上的钞票大多是1美元，但有几个人留下了5美元、10美元甚至20美元。

ex.s: Sports team owners spend millions of dollars attracting top talent
ex.t: 运动队老板花费数百万美元吸引顶尖人才

ex.t: 我___41___上课的主意，因为毕竟谁不想___42___几美元呢？

ex.s: It might seem strange to hoard a bunch of processed, strung-together shells, but what is a pile of dollars?
ex.t: 囤积一堆经过加工、串在一起的贝壳似乎有些奇怪，但一堆美元又算是什么呢？

ex.s: Sarah  63   (tell) that she could be Britain’s new supermodel, earning a million dollars in the new year.
ex.t: 萨拉____（被告知）她可能成为英国新的超模，在新的一年里赚一百万美元。

ex.s: By the time she was 13，her company was worth millions of dollars with the invention of a super-sweet treat that could save kids' teeth，instead of destroying them.
ex.t: 到她13岁时，她发明了一种超级甜食，能够保护孩子的牙齿而不是损害它们，这使她的公司价值数百万美元。

ex.s: But at Union Station in Los Angeles last month, a board went up with dollar bills attached to it with pins and a sign that read, "Give What You Can, Take What You Need."
ex.t: 但上个月在洛杉矶的联合车站，立起了一块板，上面用图钉钉着美元钞票，还有一块牌子写着：“能给多少给多少，需要多少拿多少。”

ex.s: Seventy dollars was only enough for a hand pump.
ex.t: 七十美元只够买一个手摇泵。

ex.s: By early May, emergency aid worth 9.7 million US dollars had been donated by China, with a further round of emergency aid to follow.
ex.t: 截至5月初，中国已捐赠了价值970万美元的紧急援助，随后还将提供进一步的紧急援助。

ex.s: But the fire that followed burned up hundreds of millions of dollars’ worth of buildings and homes.
ex.t: 但随后的大火烧毁了价值数亿美元的建筑和房屋。

ex.s: Countries around the globe are spending billions of dollars and lots of time on various space missions, whether to Mars or other planets much further away.
ex.t: 全球各国正在花费数十亿美元和大量时间进行各种太空任务，无论是前往火星还是其他更远的行星。

ex.s: Fifteen thousand dollars out the door!
